title: feat(app-shell): Studio right slot shows the properties or the copilot (objectui#12725, part)
body:
Part of #12725
Clause-②: no

Studio has one right slot that shows either the open item's properties or the AI copilot, per the maintainer's ruling 「按「右栏二选一」定稿」. This covers items 1, 2 and 6 and the canvas half of item 3. #12725 remains open for the rest (see Acceptance notes).

## What changed
- **One right slot** (`StudioRightSlot`, `studioRightSlotState`). It is 300 px wide below 1280 px and 360 px from 1280 px up.
  - A segmented header 属性 | AI 副驾 switches the halves; `⌘.` / `Ctrl+.` does the same.
  - The top bar's right-most icon shows or hides the slot. The choice is remembered per tab under the key the Studio dock already used, so the console dock's own keys are untouched.
  - The slot opens on the copilot. Under `md` it overlays the page and starts closed.
  - Both halves stay mounted, so a copilot turn in flight survives a look at the properties.
- **Switching by intent (Interfaces).** The pillar portals its inspector into the slot.
  - Selecting a dashboard widget or a page block (through the designer's `onSelectionChange`), or a nav entry in nav editing, switches the slot to 属性.
  - Esc, or a click on empty canvas, returns to the item's own properties.
  - While 属性 shows, the copilot is a 40 px strip at the slot's foot: 「AI 副驾 · 回到对话 →」. It adds 方案待确认 while a proposed plan awaits approval.
- **No canvas tabs.** The folded 画布 / 属性 center tabs and a source page's 源码 / 属性 tabs are gone.
  - One status line sits above the canvas (设计态 / 运行态预览 · 含未发布改动). Beside the slot it also reads 「点元素 → 右栏切到属性」 or 「已选中：… · Esc 取消选中」.
  - The item's ⋯ menu offers 查看定义 (a source page's code editor, or any other item's document as JSON) and 复制 JSON. A newly created page opens on its definition.
  - Rename and delete are not in that menu: the item header offers neither today (nav entries are renamed and removed in nav editing).
- **Pillar names from 1024 px** (`lg:not-sr-only`, was `xl:`).
- **The copilot keeps working.** `StudioChatDock` keeps its name and props. Its conversation, agent, scope and requests are unchanged; it is now the slot's body and reports `{available, planPending}` to the slot.
- **Retired with the folded layout:** `centerTab.ts`, `useIsWideViewport` / `WIDE_VIEWPORT_BREAKPOINT`, and `DOCK_STUDIO_WIDTH_STORAGE_KEY`. None of them is on the package entry: `index.ts` and `package.json` have a zero-line diff.
- New copy is in the metadata-admin designer table (en and zh), not in the language packs.

## Tests
- On merged head bd0e3d5, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: 1534 files passed, 1 skipped; 14511 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- New test files:
  - `StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725` covers the card's Acceptance 1 for the claimed items: the copilot shows with no properties; a selection switches to 属性 with the strip at the foot; Esc and an empty-canvas click return to the item's own properties; `⌘.`; the toggle under the Studio key only; no 源码 tab and the ⋯ definition; labels at `lg`; and controls.
  - `studioRightSlot-12725` covers the slot's own rules.
  - `studioCopilotSlotBody-12725` checks that the copilot drives no dock state, so the console dock's expanded state and width stay its own.
- Ablation: 8 mutants of the committed implementation (the selection → 属性 switch, Esc, the empty-canvas click, the pillar labels, the default mode, `⌘.`, the ⋯ menu, a re-added tab). All 8 went red, and every restore matched the HEAD blob.
- Re-pointed pins, each with its reason written in the test: the folded center tab (to the canvas status line), the source page's Source / Properties tabs (to the definition sheet), the `xl` labels, the dock-state wiring, four `banner` lookups (testing-library reads the aside's `header` as a second banner; a browser does not), and one fake client.
- **The console ChatDock is unchanged.** `ChatDock.tsx`'s diff is comments only. Its families pass untouched: `ChatDock.test`, `ChatDock.appBinding-10926`, `ChatDock.partialRuntimeConfig`, `ConsoleLayout.dockBinding-10926`, `chatDockState.test`, `chatDockReturnLocation`, `launcherPlanApprovalMarker-11666`.

## Live reading (Acceptance 2)
- Setup: a backend booted with `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` (published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2`), opened at Studio › ObjectStack Showcase › Interfaces › Delivery Operations, at 1010 and 1280 px, before (main 4b3d6ed) and after.
- Screenshots: branch `claude/issue-12725-evidence`, folder `evidence/12725/` (commit 72d4957), with a README.
- The community backend's agent catalog answers an empty list, so the copilot-mode screenshots stub `GET /api/v1/ai/agents` with one `build` agent in the browser. Unstubbed (`*-noai-*`), the slot holds the properties alone.
- Measured: the slot is 300 px wide at 1010 and 360 px at 1280. Clicking the Active Projects widget switched the slot to 属性 with the strip, and the hint read "Selected: Active Projects · Esc to deselect". Esc returned to the dashboard's own properties. No dock and no center tabs remain.

## Acceptance notes
- **Not this PR** (#12725 remains open for these):
  - item 3's 草稿 chip and 来源 line, which need the copilot's draft provenance per field;
  - item 4, change card v2, which needs objectstack-ai/cloud#2924's payload;
  - item 5, the 变更 badge counting drafts as they land, which needs the same provenance and payload.
- The N in 「N 项待确认」 has no source in objectui. The strip and the segment carry the boolean plan-pending marker (objectui#11666) instead of a number.
- Properties follow the selection on Interfaces only:
  - Data, Automations and Access keep their own asides, so beside them the slot shows the copilot alone. Each could claim the slot with the same seam in a follow-up.
  - On an object/view leaf (a kanban card, a column) nothing is selectable, because the published `StudioCanvasPreviewProps` carries no `onSelectionChange`. Such a leaf shows its view-level properties.
- After this change `ChatDockLauncher` has no shipped host. Retiring it would orphan the language-pack key `console.ai.dock.open`, so it stays, with a comment saying so.
- A stale doc comment in `ObjectView.tsx` still names `useIsWideViewport`.
- At 1010 px the item header truncates its title. This is not a regression: the canvas was narrower beside the old 340 px dock.
